title: 第50章 团长，我怕你找人把我给毙了
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “这是，么斯颜色？”团长汪重喜从柜子里拿出一个苹果，放在桌上。陆阳不假思索：“红色，偏粉的那种。”汪重喜又指着自已身上的军装，问：“那，这又是么斯颜色？”陆阳：“绿色，国防绿，颜色洗的有点儿发。”汪重喜摘下自已的帽子，指着脑袋上的头发问：“这个呢？”陆阳：“半黑半白，黑色偏灰。”汪重喜重新戴上帽子，得出结论：“嗯，可以了，我可以断定那绝对是个庸医，你哪个可能是色弱？就没见过哪个色弱，能把颜色讲的这么清楚？”陆阳用力点头，最终解释权，归属首长所有。汪重喜看着他：“你也莫要担心咯，不是什么大问题，只要不影响训练，就能继续留下来服役。”“当然，复检也是为了战士们的身体负责，如果真的有什么遗传病，肿瘤，心血管疾病之类的，那是肯定不能留在部队的。”陆阳能够理解：“谢谢团长。”汪重喜笑了：“我还是喜欢，你喊我老板。”陆阳笑容尴尬，他也不知道堂堂上校团长，会披着个军大衣在军人服务社里cos店老板。也难怪他手机里存着各个单位的电话。这么说昨天找自已麻烦的那俩老兵，后来应该是被处理了？毕竟，刁难新兵这件事是咱们部队绝对不能容忍，也是不被允许的，一经发现严惩不贷。汪重喜从桌上的红塔山里抽出一根，递来一个询问的眼神。“会抽烟吗？”“不抽。”“不抽好啊。”汪重喜自顾自的点上，吸了一口。“我以前呐，也不抽烟；后来慢慢的，烟不离手。”“烟不是什么好东西，你们新兵能不碰千万别碰，否则会影响训练成绩。”陆阳自然明白这个道理，吸烟会对肺活量造成一定影响，减弱心肺能力。但他也曾见过某位跑马拉松的大佬，从头到尾叼着烟跑。这就跟个人身体素质有关了，属于极个别，也是极少数情况。汪重喜招招手，让陆阳过来坐，别站着了。他还挺想和这个新兵聊聊的。陆阳也老老实实的坐了过去。“我听说，你是淋雨发烧，才被送来团部医务室挂的水？”“对。”“那你这个身体素质，有待加强咯。当初我当兵那会儿，下雨下雪还得在泥坑里头打滚，出来以后那泥巴硬邦邦的，像是兵马俑一样。”汪重喜笑呵呵的指了指他：“你要加强营养，要多吃多锻炼，把身体素质练上来；不然军装穿在身上空荡荡的，哪里有个兵的样子？”汪重喜和陆阳聊了很多，询问了他家里情况，还问他为什么不选择复读，而是来当兵？陆阳的回答和当时如出一辙，他很看好未来部队的发展前景，决心在部队里好好干。汪重喜还问了他，对两位新兵连主官有什么意见和看法？陆阳知道，这时候肯定不能乱说，必须是往死里夸。他思索片刻，把连长和指导员比作一个家庭的父亲和母亲。“父爱如山，但不善言辞，相对严肃和严厉；母爱如水，温柔细腻，无微不至，和蔼可亲。”“新兵就像是不懂事不听话，总想着玩儿的孩子；会有叛逆和抗拒，但若干年后真正回过味来，才明白其实父母都是为自已好。”汪重喜手里夹着烟，认真的看着陆阳的眼睛，似是看到了一抹与年龄不匹配的沧桑感。那种感觉，就像是把一个中年人的灵魂，给强行塞进少年郎的躯体里。都说人无法同时拥有青春，和对青春的感受。可汪重喜偏偏在陆阳身上，同时看到了这两样。短暂的接触和交谈，也让他明白，为什么这个新兵明明训练成绩并不算优异，身体素质也有些堪忧，却会被连长和指导员同时看好。汪重喜手指悬在烟灰缸上头，轻轻弹了弹：“那接下来，你有么斯打算？”陆阳：“好好训练，努力学习，考军校，当军官。”“然后呢？”“没想好呢。”“没想好就不要想。”汪重喜挥挥手：“路，是一步步走出来的；边走边想，边想边学。”“没有人知道未来的路到底通向哪里，只要你愿意努力往前走，就总能看到不一样的风景。”“当初，我只想当个小排长，结果稀里糊涂的，就当了好多年团长；现在回想起来，也是感觉蛮神奇，蛮不可思议。”陆阳细细品味着团长的这番话。前世的他总是很焦虑，想要的很多，物质欲望很强烈。困在大城市的出租屋里，朝九晚九没日没夜，似乎永远看不到未来。尤其是看到朋友圈里那些人成家立业，买车买房，诗和远方，那种焦虑和不安的感觉就变得更加强烈。正因如此，他才迫切的将本就不多的积蓄拿来投资，想要试着以小博大，结果一夜回到解放前。过去，陆阳总是急不可耐的想要一眼就看到未来的路，似乎这样心才会踏实。可随着年龄的增长，他才慢慢意识到，即便你认真规划未来，路线也不一定会往那走。为了尚未发生的事殚精竭虑，会产生大量消极情绪和负能量，也会浪费自身大量精力。活在当下，过好每一天，不必理会终点在哪，反而能走的更远。马花腾创业初期，也没料想到企鹅集团能成为国内互联网巨擘。当下的老马，也不知道阿里巴巴和移动支付能改变世界。与其空想，还不如做好眼前的事，把握好生命中的每一个机遇，剩下的交给时间来催化。正在这时，咚咚咚的敲门声响起。紧跟着门被推开，副正委拿着一张体检表从外头进来。“解决了。”“我看看。”汪重喜接过体检单，陆阳也忍不住探出头。当看到体检单上，视力那一项已经签了字盖了章，心情立马就不一样了。汪重喜笑呵呵的说：“陆阳，你可得好好感谢我们的副正委，是他磨破了嘴皮子，才让那位女医生改了金口。”陆阳赶紧起身敬礼，郑重谢过：“谢谢首长！”谭元洲摆摆手：“本就不是什么大事，原则上只要不影响日常训练就行。只是，两次检测参照标准不一样，要求也提高了，所以才把你给卡在这。”汪重喜将体检单递给陆阳，示意他可以拿回去交差了。陆阳使劲压着嘴角，伸手刚要去拿，但那张表却又被团长抽了回去。“？？？？”陆阳不明白这是什么意思。汪重喜却一脸笑意的看着他：“先前你进来的时候，是不是有些个紧张？是不是觉得，我是要找你谈谈退兵流程的事？”陆阳笑容透着尴尬，他的确做好了最坏打算。汪重喜好奇：“如果，我真要把你退回去，你会是啷个反应？”陆阳义正言辞：“坚决服从命令，一切听从指挥！”“乱扯！”“是真的！”“别人这么说，我信；但你这么说，我得抱怀疑态度。”陆阳被整不会了，难道我看着这么滑头，不靠谱吗？汪重喜笑容和煦的说：“莫要不好意思，我知道你蛮灵醒的。昨天在小卖部外头，两个老兵都没能唬住你，今回肯定也是一样。”他将桌上的钢笔插进笔帽里，别在这张体检报告单上：“放心大胆的说，你要是说得好了，这支钢笔就送给你。”谭元洲十分惊讶，显然没料到团长竟会把他最宝贝的钢笔送人？陆阳也注意到了这支钢笔上头的一排小字：【赠特三团——纪念抗米援朝胜利xx周年】这是一支造型精美，具有特殊意义的钢笔。也是上级领导，对于特三团丰功伟绩的肯定。陆阳肯定是想要的，但内心多少有些犹豫。倒不是怕团长反悔，主要是担心听完以后，他会让人把自已拖出去毙了......
content_en: "What color is this?" Wang Chongxi, the group leader, took out an apple from the cabinet and placed it on the table.Lu Yang said without thinking: "Red, pinkish." Wang Chongxi pointed to the military uniform on his body and asked: "Then, what color is this?" Lu Yang: "Green, national defense green, the color is a little hairy after washing." Wang Chongxi took off his hat, pointed to the hair on his head and asked: "Where is this?" Lu Yang:"Half black and half white, black and gray." Wang Chongxi put on his hat again and concluded: "Well, that's enough. I can conclude that he is definitely a quack. Which one of you might be color weak? Have you ever seen a color weak person who can explain the color so clearly?" Lu Yang nodded vigorously, and the final right of interpretation belonged to the chief.Wang Chongxi looked at him: "Don't worry, it's not a big problem. As long as it doesn't affect training, you can continue to serve." "Of course, reexamination is also responsible for the health of the soldiers. If there are any genetic diseases, tumors, cardiovascular diseases, etc., thenI definitely can't stay in the army." Lu Yang understood: "Thank you, commander." Wang Chongxi smiled: "I still like it, you call me boss." Lu Yang smiled awkwardly, and he didn't know that the dignified colonel would wear a military coat and cosplay as a shop owner.No wonder he has the phone numbers of various units in his mobile phone.So the two veterans who caused trouble for me yesterday should have been dealt with later?After all, making things difficult for new recruits is absolutely intolerable and unacceptable in our army, and will be punished severely if found.Wang Chongxi took out a stick from the red pagoda on the table and gave it a questioning look."Do you know how to smoke?" "No." "It's better if you don't smoke." Wang Chongxi lit it up and took a puff."I didn't smoke before, but gradually I kept smoking." "Smoking is not a good thing. You recruits must not touch it if you can, otherwise it will affect your training performance." Lu Yang naturally understands this truth. Smoking will have a certain impact on lung capacity and weaken cardiopulmonary capacity.But he has also seen a certain marathon runner holding a cigarette in his mouth from start to finish.This is related to personal physical fitness, and it is a very rare case.Wang Chongxi waved to Lu Yang and asked him to come over and sit down instead of standing.He quite wanted to talk to this new recruit.Lu Yang also sat down obediently."I heard that you had a fever in the rain, so you were sent to the regimental infirmary for water treatment?" "Yes." "Then your physical fitness needs to be improved. When I was a soldier, it rained and snowed and I had to roll in the mud puddles. After I came out, the mud was as hard as the Terracotta Warriors and Horses." Wang ChongxiPointing at him with a smile: "You need to strengthen your nutrition, eat more and exercise more, and improve your physical fitness; otherwise the military uniform will be empty on your body, and you will not look like a soldier?" Wang Chongxi chatted a lot with Lu Yang, asked about his family situation, and asked him why he didn't choose to repeat his studies instead of becoming a soldier?Lu Yang's answer was exactly the same as that time. He was very optimistic about the future development prospects of the army and was determined to do a good job in the army.Wang Chongxi also asked him what opinions he had on the two new recruit company commanders?Lu Yang knew that he must not talk nonsense at this time, he must praise to death.He thought for a moment and compared the company commander and instructor to the father and mother of a family."A father's love is like a mountain, but he is not good at words and is relatively serious and severe; a mother's love is like water, gentle and delicate, meticulous and amiable." "Recruits are like children who are ignorant and disobedient and always want to play; they will be rebellious and resistant, but when they really look back after a few years, they realize that their parents are actually doing it for their own good." Wang Chongxi held a cigarette in his hand and looked at Lu Yang's eyes seriously, as if he saw a sense of vicissitudes that did not match his age.That feeling was like forcing the soul of a middle-aged man into the body of a young man.It is said that one cannot have youth and the feeling of youth at the same time.But Wang Chongxi was focused on Lu Yang and saw these two things at the same time.The brief contact and conversation also made him understand why this recruit was favored by both the company commander and the instructor even though his training results were not excellent and his physical fitness was somewhat worrying.Wang Chongxi hung his fingers on the ashtray and flicked it: "Then what are your plans next?" Lu Yang: "Train hard, study hard, pass the military academy, and become an officer." "Then what?" "I haven't thought about it yet." "Don't think about it if you haven't thought about it." Wang Chongxi waved his hand: "The road is walked step by step; think as you go, learn as you think."No one knows where the future will lead. As long as you are willing to work hard, you will always see a different scenery.""At first, I just wanted to be a small platoon leader, but in the end, I became a regiment leader for many years. Looking back now, it feels amazing and incredible."Lu Yang savored the words of the group leader.In his previous life, he was always anxious, wanted a lot, and had strong material desires.Trapped in a rental house in a big city, working day and night from 9 to 9, it seems that I can never see the future.Especially when I see those people in my circle of friends getting married, starting a business, buying a car, a house, poetry, and distant places, the feeling of anxiety and uneasiness becomes even stronger.Because of this, he eagerly invested his small savings in an attempt to make a big gain out of something small, but ended up returning to before liberation overnight.In the past, Lu Yang was always impatient and wanted to see the future at a glance. It seemed that only in this way could he feel at ease.But as he grew older, he slowly realized that even if you carefully plan for the future, the route may not necessarily go that way.Worrying about things that have not happened yet will generate a lot of negative emotions and energy, and will also waste a lot of energy.Live in the moment, live every day well, don't worry about where the end is, and you can go further.When Ma Huateng started his business, he never expected that Penguin Group would become a domestic Internet giant.Today’s Lao Ma doesn’t know that Alibaba and mobile payment can change the world.Instead of daydreaming, it is better to do the things in front of you, seize every opportunity in life, and leave the rest to time.At this moment, there was a knock on the door.Immediately after the door was pushed open, the deputy chief came in from the outside holding a medical examination form."Solved." "Let me take a look." Wang Chongxi took the medical examination form, and Lu Yang couldn't help but poke his head out.When I saw that the vision item on the physical examination form had been signed and stamped, my mood immediately changed.Wang Chongxi said with a smile: "Lu Yang, you have to thank our deputy chief. It was his bad words that allowed the female doctor to change Chrysostomia." Lu Yang quickly stood up, saluted, and solemnly thanked: "Thank you, chief!" Tan Yuanzhou waved his hand: "I am.It's not a big deal, as long as it doesn't affect daily training.However, the reference standards for the two tests are different, and the requirements have been raised, so you are stuck here." Wang Chongxi handed the physical examination form to Lu Yang, indicating that he could take it back and submit it.Lu Yang pressed the corner of his mouth hard and stretched out his hand to take it, but the leader pulled back the watch."????" Lu Yang didn't understand what this meant.Wang Chongxi looked at him with a smile on his face: "When you came in earlier, were you a little nervous? Did you think that I wanted to talk to you about the withdrawal process?" Lu Yang smiled with embarrassment, and he was indeed prepared for the worst.Wang Chongxi was curious: "If I really want to send you back, how will you react?" Lu Yang said righteously: "Resolutely obey the order and follow the command in everything!" "Bullshit!" "It's true!" "I believe what others say, but when you say that, I have to be skeptical." Lu Yang can't be tricked. Don't I look so cunning and unreliable?Wang Chongxi said with a warm smile: "Don't be embarrassed, I know you are quite alert. Yesterday outside the canteen, the two veterans failed to scare you, and it will definitely be the same this time." He inserted the pen on the table into the cap and pinned it to the medical examination report: "Say it boldly, if you are right, this pen will be given to you." Tan Yuanzhou was very surprised. Apparently, he did not expect that the regiment leader would give away his most precious pen?Lu Yang also noticed a row of small words on the pen: [Gift to the Third Regiment—To Commemorate the xx Anniversary of the Victory in Resisting America and Aiding Korea] This is a beautifully shaped pen with special significance.It is also the superior leader's recognition of the great achievements of the Special Third Regiment.Lu Yang definitely wanted it, but he was somewhat hesitant in his heart.It's not that he's afraid that the leader will regret it, but he's mainly worried that after hearing this, he will have someone drag him out and kill him...
